content.short: Solidity Shield is an AI-powered scanner that detects vulnerabilities in Solidity smart contracts.
content.description: Solidity Shield automates smart contract security checks to improve code quality and reliability across supported chains. It helps developers write more secure code and provides users with greater assurance in the applications they interact with. The tool identifies vulnerabilities within minutes of contract submission and can scan contracts at scale, delivering a dependable, scalable approach to securing Solidity contracts for diverse projects and teams.
